text:
kevin: beginning change window for personalization-service v2.7.0 in prod-global. staged rollout 6% -> 40% over 25m. gating p95, 5xx, and error budget. starting 6% canary now.

deploy-bot: rollout started by kevin. env=prod-global, version=v2.7.0. steps=[6%:12m,40%:13m]. auto-rollback thresholds: p95>650ms or 5xx>0.4% sustained 3m. annotating window.

sentry-bot: initial health: global p95 baseline=210ms, current window=215ms, 5xx baseline=0.06%, current=0.07%. watching for regressions.

nora: spotting intermittent p95 spikes on /personalize/feed in eu-west ~4m post-canary. samples show long tail on model_load event.

infra-bot: k8s: pod personalization-45ff on node-eu12 restarted (OOMKill) at 2026-03-22T02:08:14Z.

evan: logs show heavy concurrent cache fills after v2.7.0 due to change in shard strategy. memory pressure on node-eu12.

kevin: pause ramp. keep at 6%. suggestion: throttle per-node concurrency for canary traffic to reduce concurrent cache fill. can we implement a temporary node-level token bucket or max-inflight per node for the canary?

deploy-bot: acknowledged. can apply routing policy changes or per-node caps if provided.

nora: monitoring delta (10m pre vs 5m post): /personalize/feed p95 +220ms in eu-west, 5xx +0.19%. affected nodes: node-eu12, node-eu07. Recommended mitigations: per-node concurrency cap or divert canary to warmed-pool with preloaded shards.

evan: we can patch the routing layer to add per-node max_inflight=10 for canary routes; quick config push ~45s. infra can also provision a warmed-pool(2 nodes) with preloaded shards, ETA 2m.

kevin: do both: apply per-node cap for canary and provision warmed-pool. if after cap+diversion 5xx remains >0.3% or p95 >600ms sustained 3m, we'll pin traffic to v2.6.8.

deploy-bot: per-node cap applied for canary routes: max_inflight=10. note appended: "throttle applied - investigating shard warmup".

infra-bot: warmed-pool provisioning started. ETA 120s.

sentry-bot: 3m post-throttle: eu-west p95 improved from 430ms -> 260ms; 5xx dropping to 0.09%. one OOM still logged on node-eu12 but rate decreased.

evan: warmed-pool ready and preloaded shards. diverting the 6% canary traffic to warmed-pool now.

deploy-bot: diversion completed: canary traffic routed to warmed-pool. change window note updated. auto-rollback still armed.

nora: 5m post-diversion: eu-west p95 stabilizing ~230ms, 5xx ~0.07%. overall global metrics within thresholds. recommendation: hold at 6% for full 12m monitoring window then consider ramp to 40% with warmed-only routing.

kevin: decision: hold 12m and then ramp to 40% only to warmed-pool. opening OPS ticket for a follow-up to revert shard strategy and add warmup to deploy flow: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4355. I'll update release notes: "paused ramp due to shard warmup causing memory pressure on subset of nodes; applied per-node inflight throttle and diverted canary to warmed pool; will proceed after 12m stable or pin to v2.6.8".

deploy-bot: change window annotated and ticket created. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
